name: FDR State Park
description: A scenic course set in FDR State Park with a mix of wooded and open holes. Features elevation changes and challenging terrain.

name: Brakewell Steel/Warwick - Blue Layout
description: The longer Blue layout at Brakewell Steel featuring more challenging distances and technical shots.

name: The Oasis at Warwick

name: Wolfe Woods
description: A challenging wooded course with technical shots and elevation changes. Features tight fairways and strategic basket placements.
